title: Free bifibrations of $(\infty,2)$-categories, 2-simplicial objects and the walking adjunction
summary: In this work, we develop a fibrational approach to freely adjoining adjoints in an $(\infty,2)$-category. We construct the universal bifibration obtained from a cocartesian fibration of $(\infty,2)$-categories by adjoining cartesian lifts over a chosen class of $1$-morphisms in the base. We then use this construction to provide an explicit model for freely adjoining adjoints, together with a zig-zag formula for the resulting mapping $(\infty,1)$-categories.
